title: CLI Surface Audit v1

cli_state_analysis.summary: Rig Relay has two CLIs: a compact argparse-based entrypoint (rig_relay/cli/) with ~5 subcommands, and 121 standalone scripts (scripts/rig_*.py) with no unified taxonomy, no consistent schema, no consistent dry-run default, and no consistent auth model. The scripts bypass intent gating that the cockpit enforces. Scripts can execute mutations without governance engine evaluation and without approval receipts.
cli_state_analysis.two_cli_problem: The entrypoint CLI (rig-relay) dispatches to desktop cockpit by default. Scripts are a separate universe of 121 ad-hoc commands. There is no unified command taxonomy, no shared argument parsing, no shared schema validation, and no shared governance integration between the two.
critical_gaps: No consistent dry-run default for mutation scripts
Scripts can mutate without cockpit-level governance
No consistent JSON/JSONL output mode across scripts
Most scripts produce ad-hoc JSON artifacts with no schema validation
Scripts bypass the intent gating that frontend enforces

families.default_mode: dry-run for mutations; read-only for diagnostics
dry-run (--dry-run flag); explicit --execute required for remote contribution
dry-run preview of config change; --execute required
read-only by default; preflight is dry-run; no remote mutation without --execute + approval receipt
dry-run by default for all mutation paths
families.ci_suitable: read-only commands yes; mutation commands no

cli_design_principles: Every mutating command must default to dry-run or require explicit --execute flag with approval receipt
Every command that produces structured output must produce schema-validated JSON/JSONL
Every command must have stable exit codes (0=success, 1=error, 2=blocked, 3=needs_approval, 4=rate_limited, 5=permission_denied)
No command must bypass the governance engine for operations that would require governance in cockpit
Every command should work in CI (non-interactive, deterministic, JSON output)
Scripts should be migrated into the unified CLI taxonomy over time
No Markdown-as-evidence from CLI commands; structured JSON/JSONL/CSV only
Content-light by default: no raw tokens, secrets, or file contents in CLI output
CLI commands must produce receipts for every operation
